summary: This appendix presents a comprehensive, numbered list of 141 Pāñcarātra texts, which are important scriptures in the Vaiṣṇava tradition. The title indicates that this specific list of texts (Saṁhitās) is sourced from the Viṣṇu-saṁhitā. The list is presented over three pages and appears to be from a larger work titled 'The Āgama Encyclopaedia'.
purpose: The purpose of this appendix is to provide a consolidated reference list of Pāñcarātra Saṁhitās as enumerated in the Viṣṇu-saṁhitā. It serves as a valuable resource for scholars and students of Hindu religious texts, particularly those studying the Pāñcarātra Āgama literature within Vaiṣṇavism.
key_information: The appendix provides a list of 141 Pāñcarātra texts (Saṁhitās).
The source of this list is cited as the Viṣṇu-saṁhitā.
The numbering sequence is missing item 82, jumping from 81 to 83.

Several text names appear multiple times, some with parenthetical numbers indicating different versions or sections, such as Viṣṇu-saṁhitā (1, 2, 3), Paulastya-saṁhitā (1, 2), and Pārāśarya-saṁhitā (listed twice, once with '(2)').
The pages are from a publication titled 'The Āgama Encyclopaedia'.

tables_and_data.description: A numbered list of Pāñcarātra texts, presented in a two-column format across three pages.
tables_and_data.data_summary: The list enumerates 141 texts by name, from 'Viṣṇu-saṁhitā (1)' to 'Jābāla-samhitā'. It includes many foundational texts of the Pāñcarātra school of thought.

references_to_chapters: There are no direct references to other chapters of the book. The title '(In Viṣṇu-saṁhitā)' serves as a citation for the source of the list itself.
